importMenu.fromProfileEmptyTitle: Paste your resume text on the "CV" page first
importMenu.fromProfileHelpSummary: Where does this text come from?
importMenu.fromProfileHelpBody: Paste or update your resume text on the "CV" page (under "Profile" in the sidebar) — AI will parse it into sections (Experience, Skills, Education…) here with one click.
importMenu.linkedinHelpSummary: Where do I get a LinkedIn .zip?
importMenu.linkedinHelpBody: LinkedIn → Settings & Privacy → Data Privacy → Get a copy of your data → «Want something in particular» (Profile, Positions, Skills, Education) → get the archive by email → upload the .zip here.

cvPage.howItWorksSummary: How does this work, and how do I upload from LinkedIn?
cvPage.howItWorksBody: One upload — and your CV works everywhere: market analysis, roadmap, learning plan, recommendations + auto-parsing into sections in the CV Builder. LinkedIn: profile → «More» → «Save to PDF» → upload it here (direct LinkedIn parsing is forbidden by its ToS).
